entities.summary: Vladimir Ivaonvovich Bogodukhov, is a Russian politician and army officer who had served as a member of the State Duma of the 7th convocation from 2016 to 2021, having served as a member of the State Duma Committee on Defense, and a member of the United Russia faction.
